title: Module 1: Data Cleaning Fundamentals
objective: Learn to identify and handle missing, duplicate, and inconsistent data.
concepts: NaN detection, drop_duplicates, string normalization, dtype conversion.

title: Module 2: Merging and Joining Tables
objective: Combine data from multiple sources without losing or duplicating records.
concepts: merge direction, how parameter, orphan record handling, key matching.

title: Module 3: Pivot Tables and Aggregation
objective: Summarize large datasets into meaningful cross-tabulated views.
concepts: index, columns, values, aggfunc, multi-level groupby.

title: Module 4: Custom Row Classification
objective: Apply business rules to classify records using custom logic.
concepts: apply function, row-wise operations, conditional labeling.

title: Module 5: Time Series Aggregation
objective: Summarize transactional data by time period and visualize trends.
concepts: datetime parsing, resample, monthly grouping, trend charts.
